svg.text: Header: from chip and name → to chip and name, both
in text; the time in ink-muted mono (was faint). 40px,
a hairline under it. While a turn runs, the footer
shows its badge and counts, no duration (copy.md).
The brief's first heading becomes the card's title
and isn't repeated; the rest is compact Markdown.
Folded at 8 lines: ‘Show all · 38 lines’. Links work:
the card is an article, not a button.
The footer is the button that opens the turn's
Activity: 36px row, 44px hit area; shown focused.
6: said to you, no turn: no footer, nothing to open.
Phone: from → to and the time always on one line;
names truncate at 96px each, full names in the
card's accessible name. The footer keeps the agent:
Stuck: the header is position: sticky; top: 0 inside
its own article, same push rule as Activity's bands.
The text under it always has an author on screen.
The card's end pushes its header out; the next
card's header takes the top. They never overlap.
You: a neutral slate dot and chip, never a colour.
the agent shrinks to fit, at most 72px; the badge
